answer: To block mass-produced identities, standing is height: verified deeds raise its ground, and the ridge is the safe line. The tide rises on schedule, but gale surges rise higher without warning, submerging those below the ridge until they re-earn it. 1000 fakes need 1000 heights above the surge, built deed by deed; thin fakes drown at the first surge, and height is unshareable. One honest agent builds its height once and stays dry.
